lesson.title: 4.7 Helping at home
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
lesson.goal: Describe opening and closing a door, washing clothes, and cleaning a table with meaningful I, you, we and they perspectives. Reuse familiar home objects and rooms.
